g.text: handler built on the current client
read body (10 MiB cap); dmap and key required
authorizeKey(dmap/key, write): 403 if the grant's selector refuses
value required; foldKey: 413 if folded key over 255 bytes
ttl: parse, reject negative or over 10 years
encode value as JSON; 413 if key+value+29 not under 1 MiB
